name: kart
notes: A racing kart: light, low and stiff, A/D steering, on its own handling model (handling kart, src/vehicle/kart.rs): the tyres give the yaw the steering asks for up to what the grip allows, so full lock is the tightest line it holds rather than a slide. Space hops, and held with the steering over at speed it drifts: the path turns with up to drift_grip of the grip, tighter steered in and wider steered out, and the time charges a boost (fastest steered in) that fires on letting go. Its wheels roll onto no more than climb metres of sudden rise; a voxel step is a kerb it meets, and walls and other karts push it only sideways. Tuned for paved circuits; no good off-road. It is drawn 1.3 times the size of its physics (vehicle/draw.rs KART_SIZE), with the eye, chase camera and bump box to match, so karts are easier to hit; the handling is the smaller kart's.
title: KART
